name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-bloody-font
title: Super Mario World - Bloody Font
description:
A version of the basegame SMW font but edited to be distressed, melty and bloody. Meant to be used for creepy, unsettling settings. Inspired by Damien Guard's Blood Rain font.

Includes a palette for another variant if you really want to have the text be truly blood-colored.
